blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Harbour Chines. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Harbour Chines, Coquitlam: 9 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 33% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 10 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Harbour Chines rose from 6 in June to 9 in September (+50.0%), and 7 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.1% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.

blocks.text: Harbour Chines home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 houses sold in Harbour Chines with a median price of $1,668,000 (the middle half sold between $1,504,000 and $1,912,500), taking a median of 33 days to sell at 95.6% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $659 per square foot, a median year built of 1962 and a median lot of 8,856 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Harbour Chines?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 houses listed in Harbour Chines. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Harbour Chines a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Harbour Chines had a sales ratio of 33% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Harbour Chines from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Harbour Chines over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Harbour Chines?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Harbour Chines sell for?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Harbour Chines between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,668,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Harbour Chines?
faq.a: The median was 33 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (13% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
